arxiv-2004-12462.title: Ending the COVID-19 epidemic in the United Kingdom Statistical Laboratory, University of Cambridge, Wilberforce Road, Cambridge CB3 0WB, UK; L.C.G.Rogers[AT]statslab.cam.ac.uk.
arxiv-2004-12462.creator: L. C. G. Rogers
arxiv-2004-12462.description: Abstract Social distancing and lockdown are the two main non-pharmaceutical interventions being used by the UK government to contain and control the COVID-19 epidemic; these are being applied uniformly across the entire country, even though the results of [ 3 ] show that the impact of the infection increases sharply with age.

arxiv-2010-08871.title: A statistical model to predict ignition probability
arxiv-2010-08871.creator: L. Esclapez, F. Collin-Bastiani, E. Riber, B. Cuenot
arxiv-2010-08871.description: Abstract Ignition capability is a critical design constraint for aeronautical gas turbines. However the current trend toward overall lean burn is detrimental to the engine ignition and relight and the ignition system must be adapted to ensure a fast and reliable light-round in all circumstances.

arxiv-2105-15166.title: Comment on ‘Local available quantum correlations for Bell Diagonal states and markovian decoherence’
arxiv-2105-15166.creator: David M. Bellorin R, Hermann L. Albrecht Q
arxiv-2105-15166.description: Abstract In this brief paper, we complete the analysis presented previously in [RMF 64 (2018) 662–670] regarding the quantifiers of the classical correlations and the so-called local available quantum correlations for Bell Diagonal states. A correction is introduced in their previous expressions once two cases within the optimizations are included. pacs 03.65.Ud, 03.67.-a, 03.67.Mn.

arxiv-2201-05403.title: Code-based Signatures from New Proofs of Knowledge for the Syndrome Decoding Problem
arxiv-2201-05403.creator: Loïc Bidoux 1 , Philippe Gaborit 2 , Mukul Kulkarni 1 , Victor Mateu 1
arxiv-2201-05403.description: Abstract In this paper, we study code-based signatures constructed from Proof of Knowledge (PoK). This line of work can be traced back to Stern who introduces the first efficient PoK for the syndrome decoding problem in 1993 [ Ste93 ] . Afterward, different variations were proposed in order to reduce signature’s size.

arxiv-2208-14310.title: Correlations and energy in mediated dynamics
arxiv-2208-14310.creator: Tanjung Krisnanda, Su-Yong Lee, Changsuk Noh, Jaewan Kim, Alexander Streltsov, Timothy C. H. Liew, Tomasz Paterek
arxiv-2208-14310.description: Abstract The minimum time required for a quantum system to evolve to a distinguishable state is set by the quantum speed limit, and consequently influences the change of quantum correlations and other physical properties. Here we study the time required to maximally entangle two principal systems interacting either directly or via a mediating ancillary system, under the same energy constraints.

arxiv-2210-09171.title: Data-driven Modeling of Mach-Zehnder Interferometer-based Optical Matrix Multipliers
arxiv-2210-09171.creator: Ali Cem, Siqi Yan, Yunhong Ding, Darko Zibar, and Francesco Da Ros
arxiv-2210-09171.description: Abstract Photonic integrated circuits are facilitating the development of optical neural networks, which have the potential to be both faster and more energy efficient than their electronic counterparts since optical signals are especially well-suited for implementing matrix multiplications. However, accurate programming of photonic chips for optical matrix multiplication remains a difficult challenge.

arxiv-2212-04358.title: Operator Size Distribution in Large N N Quantum Mechanics of Majorana Fermions
arxiv-2212-04358.creator: Pengfei Zhang, Yingfei Gu
arxiv-2212-04358.description: Abstract Under the Heisenberg evolution in chaotic quantum systems, initially simple operators evolve into complicated ones and ultimately cover the whole operator space. We study the growth of the operator “size” in this process, which is related to the out-of-time-order correlator (OTOC).

arxiv-2303-17704.title: Bayes-optimal inference for spreading processes on random networks
arxiv-2303-17704.creator: Davide Ghio, Antoine L. M. Aragon, Indaco Biazzo, Lenka Zdeborová
arxiv-2303-17704.description: Abstract We consider a class of spreading processes on networks, which generalize commonly used epidemic models such as the SIR model or the SIS model with a bounded number of re-infections. We analyse the related problem of inference of the dynamics based on its partial observations.

arxiv-2404-13025.title: Gravitational wave probes of Barrow cosmology with LISA standard sirens
arxiv-2404-13025.creator: Mahnaz Asghari, Alireza Allahyari, and David F. Mota
arxiv-2404-13025.description: Abstract We study the Barrow cosmological model, which proposes that quantum gravity effects create a complex, fractal structure for the universe’s apparent horizon. We leverage the thermodynamics-gravity conjecture. By applying the Clausius relation to the apparent horizon of the Friedmann-Lemaître-Robertson-Walker universe within this framework, we derive modified field equations where the Barrow entropy is linked to the horizon.

arxiv-2407-06338.title: Pattern avoidance and the fundamental bijection
arxiv-2407-06338.creator: Kassie Archer, Robert P. Laudone
arxiv-2407-06338.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Kassie Archer, Robert P. Laudone. The fundamental bijection is a bijection θ : 𝒮 n → 𝒮 n \theta:\mathcal{S}_{n}\to\mathcal{S}_{n} in which one uses the standard cycle form of one permutation to obtain another permutation in one-line form. In this paper, we enumerate the set of permutations π ∈ 𝒮 n \pi\in\mathcal{S}_{n} that avoids a pattern σ ∈ 𝒮 3 \sigma\in\mathcal{S}_{3} , whose image θ ⁡ ( π ) \theta(\pi) also avoids σ \sigma .

arxiv-2410-06042.title: Weighted Embeddings for Low-Dimensional Graph Representation Thanks: This work was supported by funding from the pilot program Core–Informatics of the Helmholtz Association (HGF).
arxiv-2410-06042.creator: Thomas Bläsius, Jean-Pierre von der Heydt, Maximilian Katzmann, Nikolai Maas
arxiv-2410-06042.description: Abstract Learning low-dimensional numerical representations from symbolic data, e.g., embedding the nodes of a graph into a geometric space, is an important concept in machine learning. While embedding into Euclidean space is common, recent observations indicate that hyperbolic geometry is better suited to represent hierarchical information and heterogeneous data (e.g., graphs with a scale-free degree distribution).

pmc-10749856.creator: Sharon Bossert, Prashin Unadkat, Kevin N. Sheth, Gordon Sze, Michael Schulder
pmc-10749856.description: Background MRI (magnetic resonance imaging) using low-magnet field strength has unique advantages for intraoperative use. We compared a novel, compact, portable MR imaging system to an established intraoperative 0.15 T system to assess potential utility in intracranial neurosurgery. Methods Brain images were acquired with a 0.15 T intraoperative MRI (iMRI) system and a 0.064 T portable MR system.

pmc-11530275.creator: Jonathan Howlett
pmc-11530275.description: se-modifying drugs — found that more aggressive drug-titration strategies offered the largest gains in quality-adjusted life years. A cost-effectiveness study looking at different scenarios of achieving optimal treatment for patients with heart failure — that is, 4 classes of disease-modifying drugs — found that more aggressive drug-titration strategies offered the largest gains in quality-adjusted life years.

pmc-11577735.title: A patient stratification signature mirrors the immunogenic potential of high grade serous ovarian cancers
pmc-11577735.creator: Laurel K Berry, Ashok K Pullikuth, Kristen L Stearns, Yuezhu Wang, Calvin J Wagner, Jeff W Chou, Janelle P Darby, Michael G Kelly, Raghvendra Mall, Ming Leung, Julia Chifman, Lance D Miller
pmc-11577735.description: BackgroundWhile high-grade serous ovarian cancer (HGSC) has proven largely resistant to immunotherapy, sporadic incidents of partial and complete response have been observed in clinical trials and case reports. These observations suggest that a molecular basis for effective immunity may exist within a subpopulation of HGSC.

pmc-11788285.title: Improved object detection method for autonomous driving based on DETR
pmc-11788285.creator: Huaqi Zhao, Songnan Zhang, Xiang Peng, Zhengguang Lu, Guojing Li
pmc-11788285.description: Object detection is a critical component in the development of autonomous driving technology and has demonstrated significant growth potential. To address the limitations of current techniques, this paper presents an improved object detection method for autonomous driving based on a detection transformer (DETR).

pmc-12730177.title: Extensive Nevus Comedonicus Treated by Comb Flap Reconstruction, Super Tension-Relieving Sutures, and Vacuum Sealing Drainage: A Case Report
pmc-12730177.creator: Hui Cheng, Xiaojing Li, Xinyi Li, Yun Bai, Wei Zhang, Boao Zhao, Tao Yang, Ping Li, Wende Yao
pmc-12730177.description: PurposeThere are few reports on the comprehensive surgical management of extensive nevus comedonicus, and the genetic mechanism of this rare disease is not yet fully understood.Patients and MethodsWe report a case of a 38-year-old woman with extensive nevus comedonicus, refractory to multiple medical treatments. She underwent comb flap reconstruction combined with super tension-relieving sutures and vacuum sealing drainage.

pmc-12848049.title: Ampere-level electroconversion of acetylene towards polymer grade ethylene via Pd-H mediated non-spillover hydrogenation
pmc-12848049.creator: Lei Bai, Xiao Han, Dingding Li, Chuncai Kong, Jingbo Shi, Mengyao She, Jintao Bai, Jinbo Bai, Kunyue Leng, Yafei Zhao, Yue Lin, Lirong Zheng, Yunteng Qu
pmc-12848049.description: Electroconversion of acetylene towards polymer-grade ethylene (EAE) is recognized as a promising substitution for thermo-catalytic route. The excessive active-hydrogen supplies a high current density induces the conspicuous hydrogen evolution, reducing the ethylene Faradaic efficiency (FE). Here, we develop a Cu-Pd single atom alloy (SAA) catalyst, achieving a 90.5% FE with a large ethylene partial current density of −1.

pmc-13216625.creator: Sara González-Arranz, Isabel Acosta, Irene Gil-Torres, Ethel Queralt, Beatriz Santos, Pedro A. San-Segundo
pmc-13216625.description: Meiotic recombination defects activate a checkpoint that delays meiotic prophase I exit in budding yeast by inhibiting Ndt80-dependent expression of the cyclin CLB1 and the polo-like kinase CDC5. Additionally, Swe1-mediated inhibitory phosphorylation of Cdk1/Cdc28 on tyrosine 19 reinforces this arrest.

pmc-13462893.title: Human umbilical cord mesenchymal stem cells derived exosomes enhance the therapeutic efficacy of anti-miR-10b in glioblastoma
pmc-13462893.creator: Saeideh Sadeghi Neshat, Masoud Soleimani, Zahra Madjd, Mehdi Dianatpour, Faezeh Vakhshiteh
pmc-13462893.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Glioblastoma multiforme (GBM) remains a highly aggressive brain tumor with limited therapeutic options. MicroRNA-10b (miR-10b) is consistently overexpressed in GBM and absent in normal astrocytes, making it a potential therapeutic target. In this study, we evaluated the feasibility of using human umbilical cord mesenchymal stem cell (hUC-MSC)-derived exosomes as delivery vehicles for Locked Nucleic Acid anti-miR-10b-5p (LNA-anti-10b) in U87MG glioblastoma cells. Exosomes were isolated by ultracentrifugation and loaded with LNA-anti-10b. Delivery efficiency was compared with lipofectamine-mediated transfection.
